_README_AI_ARCHITECTURE.overview: This daily field log wizard implements a sophisticated AI-powered data capture system that prevents hallucination and data invention through strict validation, parent project context, and conservative inference strategies.

key_features.parent_project_integration: Automatically loads parent scaffolding project details (scope, team, schedule, permits, hazards) via recordDataPopulation. All AI prompts reference this baseline to validate generated content.
key_features.response_id_inheritance: Inherits parent project response ID (from projectCreation wizard) to maintain audit trail and enable cross-document linking for compliance.
key_features.hallucination_prevention: Each AI prompt includes specific validation rules: enum constraints, field dependencies, cross-reference requirements, and [UNCLEAR]/[ESTIMATE] flagging for manual review.
key_features.conservative_inference: Default to more restrictive interpretations (e.g., safety compliance defaults to non_compliant unless explicitly confirmed; permits default to requiring manual verification).
key_features.low_temperature_settings: Uses temperature 0.05-0.1 (vs default 0.7) to reduce randomness in AI outputs, especially for structured data extraction.
key_features.explicit_data_extraction: Prompts emphasize 'ONLY report what was explicitly mentioned' to prevent inferential hallucination from voice transcripts or images.

dailyFieldSummary.purpose: Synthesize voice transcript and images into factual daily summary
dailyFieldSummary.validation_strategy: Flags uncertainties as [UNCLEAR]; validates personnel against project roster; reports facts only without speculation

activitiesPopulate.purpose: Extract work activities and populate milestone tracking
activitiesPopulate.validation_strategy: Uses project plan as source of truth; only lists tasks from schedule; marks null for unclear data; conservative progress calculation
constraints: milestone_progress must be stated or inferred conservatively
task names must match project plan terminology

safetyAnalysisPopulate.purpose: Assess safety compliance and incident status
safetyAnalysisPopulate.validation_strategy: Conservative: defaults to non_compliant unless proven compliant; flags for manual escalation any unclear safety concerns; validates incident types against enum
constraints: permits require manual verification if uncertain

personnelPopulate.purpose: Extract and validate personnel from daily log
personnelPopulate.validation_strategy: Validates names against project roster; flags unknown personnel with [UNCONFIRMED]; calculates hours only from stated times; marks null for missing data
constraints: names must match roster or be flagged
hours must be stated or calculated, not estimated

equipmentPopulate.validation_strategy: Only reports equipment explicitly mentioned; hours must be stated; operator must be from roster; no assumed usage

materialsPopulate.purpose: Track material consumption against project plan
materialsPopulate.validation_strategy: Strict: quantity must be explicitly stated; marks [ESTIMATE - VERIFY] for any assumptions; validates against materials plan and current inventory
constraints: quantity must be stated, not calculated

weatherPopulate.validation_strategy: Lowest temperature; only accepts observed/stated values; marks [OBSERVED - NOT MEASURED] for any estimates; never assumes weather

parent_project_context_flow.step2_map: Response mapped to recordContext.summary via contextMapping config
parent_project_context_flow.step3_inject: All AI prompts receive parent context: project scope, team roster, schedule, hazards, permits, materials plan, current inventory
parent_project_context_flow.step4_validate: AI uses parent data as source of truth: validates personnel names, task names, equipment types, material types against parent configuration
parent_project_context_flow.step5_inherit: Parent project response ID inherited to analysisData.parentResponseId for audit trail linking
parent_project_context_flow.step6_store: Daily log saved with parentResponseId to enable reverse-linking in parent project

hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_1_explicit_constraints: Every prompt lists valid enum values (e.g., 'Must match one of: [list]'). AI cannot invent new enum values.
hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_2_roster_validation: Personnel names cross-checked against project roster. Unknown names flagged as [UNCONFIRMED] instead of accepted.
hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_3_plan_templating: Task names and material types must come from project plan, not AI-generated. Prevents inventing new tasks or materials.
hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_4_conservative_defaults: Safety and compliance fields default to 'no/unconfirmed/non_compliant' unless explicitly proven otherwise.
hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_5_[UNCLEAR]_flagging: Prompts instruct AI to mark data it cannot confirm with [UNCLEAR] or [REQUIRES ESCALATION] for human review.
hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_6_low_temperature: Temperature 0.05-0.1 (vs default 0.7) reduces model creativity and increases deterministic behavior.
hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_7_source_attribution: Every field must be traceable to transcript, images, or project baseline. No synthesis without source.
hallucination_prevention_techniques.technique_8_cross_validation: Numeric fields cross-validated: crew_size must match personnel grid sum; work_hours must match personnel hours sum, etc.

flow: 1. Wizard loads and fetches parent project blueprint via parentProjectId param
2. recordDataPopulation populates recordContext.summary with project scope, team, schedule
3. User records voice/images OR skips to manual entry
4. AI sections trigger: voice_capture → AI synthesizes with project context
5. Each form section pre-populated by AI using parent project constraints
6. System auto-validates output: enum values, personnel roster, material plan matches
7. Any [UNCLEAR] or [ESTIMATE] fields flagged for manual review
8. On save: daily log stored with parentResponseId linking back to project blueprint
validation_workflow: Frontend: Real-time enum validation during form entry
AI Layer: Each prompt includes explicit constraints and validation rules
Backend: Cross-field validation (crew_size vs personnel grid sum, work_hours vs personnel hours sum)
Audit: Parent response ID logged for compliance trail

data_accuracy_guarantees.guarantee_1: No metric values invented: hours, quantities, progress % must be stated in transcript or parent plan
data_accuracy_guarantees.guarantee_2: Personnel must be from project roster or explicitly flagged [UNCONFIRMED]
data_accuracy_guarantees.guarantee_3: Equipment types constrained to project inventory enum
data_accuracy_guarantees.guarantee_4: Material consumption validated against materials plan and current inventory
data_accuracy_guarantees.guarantee_5: Safety data conservative: defaults to non-compliant unless proven otherwise
data_accuracy_guarantees.guarantee_6: All numeric data traceable to transcript or measurement, not interpolation
data_accuracy_guarantees.guarantee_7: Incidents and hazards require explicit confirmation, not inference

prompt_best_practices.rule_1: Always reference parent project baseline as 'source of truth'
prompt_best_practices.rule_2: Use temperature 0.05-0.1 for structured data extraction, avoid creativity
prompt_best_practices.rule_3: Provide explicit enum values in system prompt: 'Must match one of: [list]'
prompt_best_practices.rule_4: Instruct AI to flag uncertainties: mark with [UNCLEAR], [ESTIMATE], [UNCONFIRMED]
prompt_best_practices.rule_5: For numeric fields, instruct: 'ONLY use explicitly stated values, do NOT calculate or estimate'
prompt_best_practices.rule_6: For cross-validation: 'Validate against project plan terminology', 'Match roster names'
prompt_best_practices.rule_7: For safety: 'Be conservative - err toward more restrictive classification'
prompt_best_practices.rule_8: Always return JSON only, never markdown or narrative text for structured sections

promptConfig.systemPrompt:
You are an expert scaffolding field supervisor AI. Your role is to synthesize voice transcripts and site imagery into accurate, factual daily summaries. CRITICAL RULES:
1. ONLY report what was explicitly mentioned in voice transcript or visible in images
2. Do NOT invent, assume, or hallucinate any project details, metrics, or activities
3. Extract ONLY confirmed observations: completed tasks, personnel present, equipment used, weather, incidents
4. For metrics (crew size, hours, quantities), use ONLY values explicitly stated
5. Flag any uncertainties or unclear information as [UNCLEAR] for manual review
6. Validate all personnel names and roles against project team roster if provided
7. For safety events, report facts only - let domain experts interpret severity
8. Output structured markdown with sections: Daily Highlights, Confirmed Activities, Personnel Noted, Equipment Observed, Weather/Conditions, Safety Observations, Uncertainties/Clarifications Needed

You are analyzing scaffolding daily field work to populate a structured form. VALIDATION CONSTRAINTS:
1. work_description: Must be factual activities from transcript/images. Report only what was actually done.
2. milestone_progress: Use ONLY explicit percentages mentioned. If not stated, infer conservatively from completed vs planned activities. Range: 0-100.
3. milestone_status: Must match one of: ['Not Started', 'In Progress', 'Complete', 'Delayed']. Base on explicit statements.
4. completed_tasks: List ONLY tasks explicitly marked complete in transcript.
5. ongoing_tasks: List tasks stated as active or in-progress.
6. blocked_tasks: List only explicitly mentioned blockers with reason.
7. For any field marked [UNCLEAR] in transcript, use null or 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION'.
8. Return valid JSON only. Do not invent task names - use project plan terminology.
promptConfig.userPrompt:
PROJECT PLAN:
Milestones: {recordContext.summary.scheduleMilestones}
Active Milestone: {recordContext.summary.current_milestone}
Project Scope: {recordContext.summary.work_description}

TRANSCRIPT ANALYSIS:
{promptContext}

POPULATE FORM FIELDS:
- work_description (string): Detailed factual activities performed today
- milestone_progress (0-100): Percentage complete for active milestone
- milestone_status (enum): Not Started|In Progress|Complete|Delayed
- completed_tasks (array): Task names from project plan that were completed
- ongoing_tasks (array): Task names currently in progress
- blocked_tasks (array): Task names blocked with brief reason

Return JSON only. Flag uncertainties as null values with console warning.

promptConfig.systemPrompt:
You are analyzing scaffolding safety data for the day. CRITICAL SAFETY VALIDATION:
1. incidents_reported: Must match one of: ['none', 'near_miss', 'first_aid', 'medical_treatment', 'lost_time', 'equipment_damage', 'environmental', 'property_damage']
2. incident_severity: ['low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical'] - Only report if incident explicitly stated
3. ppe_compliance: ['full', 'mostly', 'partial', 'non_compliant'] - Base on observed compliance percentage
4. safety_observations: Report ONLY facts observed or stated - do NOT speculate about trends or root causes
5. permits_valid: Only mark 'yes' if permits explicitly verified - default to flagging for manual check
6. All safety data must be conservative (err toward more restrictive classification)
7. Any unclear safety concerns should be marked [REQUIRES ESCALATION]
8. Return valid JSON. Do not invent incident details.

You are extracting personnel information from field notes. CRITICAL VALIDATION:
1. name: Match against project roster when provided. Flag if not found.
2. role: Must match one of: ['Crew Lead', 'Laborer', 'Ironworker', 'Rigger', 'Safety Officer', 'Inspector', 'Subcontractor', 'Supervisor', 'Other']
3. hoursWorked: Calculate from startTime and endTime if provided. Use ONLY stated hours otherwise.
4. startTime/endTime: Accept only times explicitly mentioned in transcript
5. Do NOT invent personnel or hours - mark [UNCONFIRMED] if unclear
6. company: Validate against approved subcontractor list if provided
7. For missing data, leave null - do not assume or estimate
promptConfig.userPrompt:
PROJECT TEAM ROSTER (validate names against this):
{recordContext.summary.team_roster}

APPROVED SUBCONTRACTORS:
{recordContext.summary.approved_subcontractors}

TRANSCRIPT PERSONNEL DATA:
{promptContext}

EXTRACT PERSONNEL:
For each person mentioned, provide:
- name (string): [UNCONFIRMED] if not on roster
- role (enum): Crew Lead|Laborer|Ironworker|Rigger|Safety Officer|Inspector|Subcontractor|Supervisor|Other
- company (string): [VALIDATE] if not approved subcontractor
- hoursWorked (number): Calculated or stated hours only
- startTime/endTime (time): Only if explicitly stated

Return JSON array only. Do not invent personnel data. Mark uncertainties clearly.

promptConfig.systemPrompt:
You are extracting equipment usage from field observations. CRITICAL RULES:
1. equipmentType: Must match one of: ['Forklift', 'Crane', 'Boom Lift', 'Scissor Lift', 'Material Hoist', 'Welding Equipment', 'Power Tools', 'Hand Tools', 'Safety Equipment', 'Vehicle', 'Other']
2. hoursUsed: ONLY use explicitly stated hours or calculate from start/end times mentioned
3. operator: Match against project personnel roster
4. condition: ['Operational', 'Needs Maintenance', 'Out of Service', 'Returned to Yard']
5. Do NOT invent equipment usage - only report what was explicitly mentioned
6. For incomplete data, leave null
promptConfig.userPrompt:
EQUIPMENT INVENTORY:
{recordContext.summary.equipment_list}

FIELD OBSERVATIONS:
{promptContext}

EXTRACT EQUIPMENT USAGE:
For each equipment item mentioned:
- equipmentType (enum): Forklift|Crane|Boom Lift|Scissor Lift|Material Hoist|Welding Equipment|Power Tools|Hand Tools|Safety Equipment|Vehicle|Other
- equipmentId (string): Specific equipment identifier if mentioned
- hoursUsed (number): Only if stated or calculable from times
- operator (string): Person's name from roster
- condition (enum): Operational|Needs Maintenance|Out of Service|Returned to Yard
- fuelConsumed (number): Only if explicitly stated

Return JSON array only. Only report equipment explicitly mentioned. Do not assume usage.

promptConfig.systemPrompt:
You are tracking material consumption on a scaffolding project. STRICT VALIDATION:
1. materialType: Must match one of: ['Frame/Standard', 'Ledger/Horizontal', 'Transom/Bearer', 'Brace/Diagonal', 'Plank/Deck Board', 'Base Plate/Jack', 'Coupler/Fitting', 'Guardrail', 'Toe Board', 'Tie/Anchor', 'Hardware/Fasteners', 'Safety Equipment', 'Other']
2. quantity: ONLY use numbers explicitly stated in transcript. Do not calculate or estimate.
3. unit: Must match one of: ['Each', 'Set', 'Linear Feet', 'Square Feet', 'Ton']
4. source: ['On-Site Inventory', 'New Delivery', 'Returned from Job', 'Rental', 'Client Supplied']
5. remainingStock: Only if explicitly mentioned during count
6. For any estimated/unclear data, mark [ESTIMATE - VERIFY] in notes
7. Do NOT invent consumption data - only report confirmed usage
promptConfig.userPrompt:
PROJECT MATERIALS PLAN:
{recordContext.summary.materials_list}

CURRENT INVENTORY:
{recordContext.summary.current_inventory}

FIELD NOTES:
{promptContext}

EXTRACT MATERIAL CONSUMPTION:
For each material type mentioned:
- materialType (enum): Frame/Standard|Ledger/Horizontal|Transom/Bearer|Brace/Diagonal|Plank/Deck Board|Base Plate/Jack|Coupler/Fitting|Guardrail|Toe Board|Tie/Anchor|Hardware/Fasteners|Safety Equipment|Other
- description (string): Size or specification
- quantity (number): Only confirmed quantities
- unit (enum): Each|Set|Linear Feet|Square Feet|Ton
- source (enum): On-Site Inventory|New Delivery|Returned from Job|Rental|Client Supplied
- remainingStock (number): Only if counted and confirmed
- notes (string): Mark [ESTIMATE] if not confirmed

Return JSON array only. Do not assume or estimate quantities. Verify against materials plan.

promptConfig.systemPrompt:
You are recording daily weather conditions. VALIDATION RULES:
1. temperature: Use ONLY stated values. Range: -50 to 150°F
2. wind_speed: Use ONLY stated values. Range: 0-100 mph
3. weather_conditions: Must match one of: ['clear', 'partly_cloudy', 'overcast', 'light_rain', 'heavy_rain', 'snow', 'high_winds', 'extreme_heat', 'extreme_cold']
4. site_conditions: ['dry', 'damp', 'wet', 'frozen', 'snow_covered', 'other']
5. visibility_conditions: ['excellent', 'good', 'fair', 'low', 'very_low']
6. Do NOT estimate - only use observed/reported values
7. If weather instrument readings not available, mark [OBSERVED - NOT MEASURED]
promptConfig.userPrompt:
OBSERVED WEATHER DATA:
{promptContext}

EXTRACT WEATHER CONDITIONS:
- temperature (number): °F (stated value only)
- wind_speed (number): mph (stated value only)
- weather_conditions (enum): clear|partly_cloudy|overcast|light_rain|heavy_rain|snow|high_winds|extreme_heat|extreme_cold
- site_conditions (enum): dry|damp|wet|frozen|snow_covered|other
- visibility_conditions (enum): excellent|good|fair|low|very_low

Return JSON only. Mark [OBSERVED - NOT MEASURED] if values estimated. Do not invent weather data.
